subject: DONE s329b: rename ./runpl → ./runpcl (clean cut, no symlink; USER ruling)
description:
USER note (2026-08-02, s328): the `./runpl` helper script should be renamed to `./runpcl` — it runs Perl through PCL, and the current name reads like "run perl".

Scope when done: rename the script; update every reference (CLAUDE.md, docs/*.md, tools/*, Pl/t/*.t helpers, memory files, session-log conventions). Decide whether to keep a `runpl` symlink for one release or cut it clean — ask the user if unclear. Sibling scripts `./runt` and `./clt` may deserve the same look while in there.
